proof_body:
by
  intro k hk z
  have hs : ((Real.sqrt k : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = k := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hk.le]
  have he : -(k : ℂ) = ((Real.sqrt k : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, hs, Complex.I_sq]
    ring
  rw [he, sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg]
target_source: ∀ k : ℝ, 0 < k → ∀ z : ℂ, z ^ 2 = -(k : ℂ) ↔ z = (Real.sqrt k : ℂ) * Complex.I ∨ z = -((Real.sqrt k : ℂ) * Complex.I)
